analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is caused by an out-of-bounds access to the 'operands' array in the 'get_number_of_operands' function. This occurs when the function iterates through the operands without properly checking the array bounds, leading to potential access of unallocated memory when the index exceeds the size of the 'operands' array.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The vulnerability can be triggered when 'get_number_of_operands' is called with an instruction that has more operands than the defined maximum (MAX_OPERANDS). In this case, an invalid index is accessed, resulting in a crash.
